messages:
maria: Heads-up — sampleapp onboarding hit a weird combo of issues with the embed/rerank path. After an auth retry loop we wind up with `vectors: null` in the response and downstream code explodes. Opening here to capture repro and get SDK parity eyes.

sam: Ugh. Can you paste the exact request payload + client SDK + server SDK versions?

maria: JS SDK v1.6.2, server running internal-infer v2026.03.16. Request body (sanitized):
```json
{
  \"model\": \"open-embedding-small\",
  \"inputs\": [\"a short doc\", \"another doc\"],
  \"batcher\": { \"max_batch_size\": 8, \"pad_to_max\": true },
  \"client_sdk\": \"js\"
}
```

jess: Two initial notes: 1) our JS helper emits field `vectors` while Python/Rust helpers use `embeddings`. 2) the batcher helper currently pads with stringified zeros ("0") for some historical reason. That can confuse downstream float parsers.

ashok: Also seeing auth refresh loop in the logs: client gets 401, triggers token refresh, then sends same request rapidly -> service rate-limits with 429 and our retry backoff isn't applied when using the helper. Logs: `401 -> REFRESH -> 429 -> retry immediate -> 200 (vectors:null)`

ai-ops: That chain is rough. Workaround for now: set `batcher.pad_to_max = false` and disable the helper retry wrapper. That avoids the string-zero pad and the double-send during refresh. Might be slower but stable.

sam: Can you show the raw response envelope that had `vectors: null`?

maria: Sure: 
```json
{
  \"status\": \"ok\",
  \"request_id\": \"r_123abc\",
  \"vectors\": [null, [0,0,0, ...]],
  \"meta\": { \"model\": \"open-embedding-small\" }
}
```

jess: So mixed types in the envelope + inconsistent field name. If Rust/Python return `embeddings: [[...],[...]]` and JS returns `vectors: [null,...]` we get parity bugs in sampleapp plumbing.

ashok: Reproduction notes: if the token is about to expire, our JS auth helper does a refresh that completes after the initial request was already dispatched. The helper then replays the request w/o exponential backoff. Server sees two near-simultaneous requests and collapses/kills one path, returning an empty placeholder in the envelope.

maria: Minimal repro added to /repos/sampleapp/examples/embed-onboard (PR soon). To reproduce locally: force token expiry, enable batcher pad_to_max true, send 2-4 docs.

ai-ops: Suggested short-term fixes:
- Normalize envelope mapping in the JS SDK to `embeddings` (server accepts both)
- Ensure pad uses numeric 0.0 and not string \"0\"
- Add jittered exponential backoff to auth replay path

sam: Those sound right. Jess — can you lead the SDK patch for field normalization + pad type fix? I can take the auth backoff change.

jess: Yep. I'll open a patch for JS v1.6.3 that maps `vectors` -> `embeddings` and fixes pad type. Also will add an integration test that verifies parsing both envelope shapes.

maria: Thank you. I filed internal ticket INFR-9876 and linked the sampleapp PR to it. Leaving logs and the small repro in the issue.

dev-bot: Deploy scheduled: JS SDK release v1.6.3 (patch) -> canary tomorrow 09:00 PT :rocket:

ashok: Filed an ops playbook note to avoid auto-replay for auth until backoff is in.

maria: Confirmed local workaround works (disabled helper retry + pad_to_max=false). Will update onboarding guide to mention this temporary step.

jess: Will post PR link here when it's up. Thanks for catching this — parity bugs like envelope names are such a pain. :thumbsup:
